<script setup>
import { onMounted, watch, computed, toRef } from "vue";
import { useRoute } from "vue-router";
import { useUserAlerts } from "./useUserAlerts";
import UserAlertBanner from "./components/UserAlertBanner.vue";
import UserAlertModal from "./components/UserAlertModal.vue";

const props = defineProps({
  userId: {
    type: [Number, null],
    default: null,
  },
  viewName: {
    type: String,
    default: null,
  },
  shouldHide: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false,
  },
});

const route = useRoute();
const userIdRef = toRef(() =>
  props.userId != null ? parseInt(props.userId, 10) : null,
);

const computedViewName = computed(() => {
  if (props.viewName) {
    return props.viewName;
  }
  return route?.name;
});

const { bannerAlerts, modalAlerts, fetchAlerts, dismissAlert } = useUserAlerts(
  userIdRef,
  computedViewName,
);

onMounted(() => {
  if (props.userId != null && !isNaN(Number(props.userId))) {
    fetchAlerts();
  }
});

watch([() => props.userId, () => route.name], ([newUserId]) => {
  if (newUserId != null && !isNaN(Number(newUserId))) {
    fetchAlerts();
  }
});

const handleBannerDismiss = (alertId, type) => {
  dismissAlert(alertId, type);
};

// Handler for modal dismissal
const handleModalDismiss = (alertId, type) => {
  dismissAlert(alertId, type);
};
</script>

<template v-if="!shouldHide">
  <UserAlertBanner
    :banner-alerts="bannerAlerts"
    @dismiss="handleBannerDismiss"
  />

  <UserAlertModal :modal-alerts="modalAlerts" @dismiss="handleModalDismiss" />

  <slot />
</template>
